name: Simple Todo
description: A to-do list in the sidebar: Markdown to-dos with priorities, due days, tags and lists, tagged with your Orca projects, that you can hand to an agent and follow. Open to-dos show in the status bar.

cover.alt: The Simple Todo panel in Orca: to-do cards with priorities, due days, tags and an agent at work on one of them.

settings.title: Text before a to-do sent to an agent
settings.description: Put before the to-do's text when you send it to an agent, for example: Work on this and report back when done.
settings.placeholder: Work on this and report back when done:

settings.title: Mark a to-do done when its agent finishes
settings.description: When the agent a to-do was sent to has worked and then finished, mark the to-do done.

settings.title: Let agents add to-dos
settings.description: Keeps a simple-todo skill in ~/.agents/skills, linked into ~/.claude/skills, that tells coding agents how to add a to-do. Turning it off removes the skill. A skill of that name you installed or changed yourself is left alone.

settings.title: Archive done to-dos after (days)
settings.description: Done to-dos older than this move to Archived. 0 never archives.

settings.title: Remind me when a to-do is due
settings.description: Show a desktop notification when a to-do becomes due or overdue.
